title: Codewars 7kyu: Mumbling (accum)
description: Given a string `st`, return a formatted string following the pattern: accum('abcd') -> 'A-Bb-Ccc-Dddd', accum('RqaEzty') -> 'R-Qq-Aaa-Eeee-Zzzzz-Tttttt-Yyyyyyy'.
solution:
def accum(st: str) -> str:
    return '-'.join(ch.upper() + ch.lower() * i for i, ch in enumerate(st))
explanation: Formats each token with 1 uppercase and i lowercase characters in O(N^2) time.
